'''Pichaff''' was a [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] in the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] and the Rapid Deployment Commander for the attack on the [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor Shipyards]]. Pichaff didn't believe [[Darth Caedus]]' plan to attack [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]] was sound and questioned his sanity. The deployment team wasn't able to deploy on the shipyards as the [[Fondorian]]s had been previously warned by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].
